questions.stem: What is the product when ethene reacts with steam in the presence of a phosphoric acid catalyst?
questions.explanation: When ethene reacts with steam (H2O) using a phosphoric acid (H3PO4) catalyst at 300 degrees C and high pressure, ethanol is produced. This addition reaction is called hydration and is the industrial method for producing ethanol: C2H4 + H2O -> C2H5OH.
